notes:
Inbound lead from Stripe checkout on landing page. Small CS automation startup building a lightweight ticket summarizer + actions layer.
- Wants structured JSON output: {summary, priority, suggested_tags, follow_up_steps} — must be deterministic for downstream parsers.
- Tool calling requirement: from LLM -> internal ticketing API (POST /tickets/:id/actions) to set status/assign; needs straightforward examples.
- Latency target: p95 < 350ms for short summaries (<= 120 tokens). Cost sensitive: aim to keep avg cost < $0.02 per ticket.
- Current stack: Node backend + Postgres + Zapier integration; planning to use hosted API for self-serve onboarding (want fast time-to-value).
- Security: SSO for admin console (SAML), audit logs for ticket changes; data residency not critical (US only).
- Quote from CTO on 2/24 call: "We need responses that our parser never fails on — strict schema or we'll break downstream flows."
- They ran a tiny POC on free credits: summary quality good but want more consistent key ordering and string types (no arrays unless explicitly requested).
- Interested in Redwood Optimize tips for batching and prefix caching to reduce token spend during bulk ingestion.
- Not yet budgeted for Dedicated; early preference for self-serve hosted API and clear docs / sample server code.
- AE notes: good product-market fit, fast decision maker (founder-led). Low friction but price-sensitive.
